encoding: 01 followed by COBS(body + CRC16-CCITT-FALSE LE) and a zero delimiter
freshness: age_ms is rounded up from trigger to ACK creation. Using the correlated host request-send time minus age_ms gives a conservative host timestamp.
delivery: At most one new observation after a STATUS or DRIVE acknowledgement. Lost, invalid, incompatible, old or repeated observations cannot establish Clear.
